I've had a good look through the whole thing, and it all hangs together the way I hoped. My library greets me with my saved links laid out readable and skimmable, the side navigation gives me All bookmarks, Read Later, and Archive as their own clear places, and everything we settled piece by piece is here and working as one app: saving turns a pasted link into a proper card, my labels sit on the cards with add, remove, and filtering, the plain search and the richer exact/any/exclude/by-label searching are all there, the read-later queue holds my unfinished reading, archiving tucks things away reversibly while delete asks me to confirm before it's final. And it remembers my bookmarks between visits, which is the whole point of a place to keep them.

On the private notes: I'm content to leave that for a later round. You've correctly noted it wasn't one of the things we actually nailed down together this time — I only mentioned it in passing — so it's fair to record it as the next thing to add rather than something missing from what we agreed. I'd like it picked up next cycle, but it doesn't hold up what's in front of me.

So yes — this is the bookmark app I set out to have, and it does what we agreed it would. I accept it, and I'm happy to close out this cycle, with private notes on the list for next time.
